name: One Arm Against Wall
instructions: From a standing position, place a bent arm against a wall or doorway.
Slowly lean toward your arm until you feel a stretch in your lats.
prompt: This is a One Arm Against Wall for stretching that uses static force to primarily train the lats. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "From a standing position, place a bent arm against a wall or doorway. Slowly lean toward your arm until you feel a stretch in your lats."
